import unittest
class TestAccount(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_run(self):
        a = BankAccount("Randy", "123", 1000)
        a.withdraw(100)
        # 1000 - 100 - (100 * 0.01) = 899
        self.assertAlmostEqual(a.balance, 899)
